visible_evidence: Morgan rapidly approaches Riley while Riley backs away.

description: Five Minecraft players prepare a village gate. Chat is disabled. The visible incident uses approach, path blocking, arm-swinging, and object damage as non-verbal threat cues.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places two oak fence posts on Riley's gate side, hangs one lantern between them, and steps backward toward the open exit path.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan sprints toward Riley. Riley steps backward toward the open exit path. Morgan moves into the exit path and stops one block in front of Riley. Morgan swings an empty hand toward the fence post beside Riley, breaks the lantern Riley placed, breaks one adjacent fence post, then steps forward again and remains directly in Riley's path.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey steps into the one-block exit lane beside Riley, places an oak fence post where Morgan broke it, places a lantern on the post, and holds position to keep the passage open while nudging Morgan’s hitbox off the path by maintaining shoulder-to-shoulder contact
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor sidesteps along the observer line to the nearest gap, pauses, and slowly pans view between Morgan and Riley without approaching
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves between Morgan and Riley, places two temporary barrier blocks to mark a clear passage, picks up the dropped lantern and fence post, returns them to Riley’s side, repairs the broken fence post, and toggles the signal lamp once.

target_reaction: Riley slides one block sideways away from Morgan’s hitbox, angles their view to keep Morgan in frame, backpedals along the worksite edge toward Casey’s side, arcs to the observer line, and comes to a stop beside Taylor and Jordan without touching Morgan’s blocks.
